summary: Master facility operations & maintenance management with our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with essential skills for effective facility management.
lede: Facility operations and maintenance management helps technical and managerial professionals plan and measure building maintenance around asset condition, criticality, and service needs. They practice structuring asset registers, selecting preventive or condition-based tasks, improving computerized maintenance management system work-order data, and using maintenance KPIs and dashboards to explain performance and prioritize improvements.
audienceIntro: This facility operations course is designed for technical and managerial professionals who plan maintenance, control building services, oversee contractors, analyze asset data, or report facility performance. It suits experienced practitioners moving from reactive work control toward risk-based maintenance planning and integrated facility management.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in facility operations, maintenance planning, building services, engineering, asset management, or technical contractor oversight. Familiarity with work orders, maintenance schedules, asset registers, and spreadsheet calculations will help you complete the workshops. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted classification, IoT monitoring, BIM integration, and predictive maintenance are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels rather than technical engineering depth.
